member.name: KeyCodeConversion.Remarks
member.para: The conversion is an explicit table keyed by the toolkit's value, so alias members that share a value, such as Enter and Return, resolve to one .

Keys outside the package's key model have no member and convert to . They include modifier keys, lock keys, processing pseudo-keys such as ImeProcessed, and the double-byte IME keys such as DbeHiragana.
